name: inkubator
description: Local-first desktop application for the management and cataloging of fountain pen and ink collections.

scripts.build:win: npm run clean:bundles && tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.build:mac: npm run clean:bundles && tauri build --bundles dmg,app
scripts.build:linux: npm run clean:bundles && tauri build --bundles deb,rpm
scripts.build:linux:deb: npm run clean:bundles && tauri build --bundles deb
scripts.build:linux:rpm: npm run clean:bundles && tauri build --bundles rpm
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo check --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.test: node --test tests/critical-persistence.test.js tests/data-schema.test.js tests/public-data.test.js tests/release-version.test.js tests/version-consistency.test.js tests/arch-package.test.js tests/linux-package.test.js tests/docker-cache.test.js tests/docker-backup-route.test.js tests/docker-public-privacy.test.js tests/docker-image-retention-route.test.js tests/backup-archive.test.js tests/backup-schedule.test.js
scripts.verify: npm run check:node && npm run check:syntax && npm run check:version && git diff --check && npm test && npm run test:renderer && npm run check:rust
